about: Research data files under data/research that no non-test file in src/ or scripts/ reads, and why (tests/guards/research-data-has-reader.test.ts). rawSource entries are evidence the game is not meant to read. awaitingReader entries are research waiting for the code that should read it: that list may only shrink (the guard holds it at or under its ceiling), so an entry must leave in the same change that gives its file a reader. Each names its engine and the squad that owns its reader, from docs/codex/audit-by-engine-2026-10-01.md. A new data file with no reader and no entry fails the guard.

awaitingReader.reason: Law catalog terms, batch 2; the old engine's legal-outcome.ts cites it as a source but nothing reads the file. Owner: the Coordinator owns the shared law path the catalog feeds.
The 61 kinds of bill part (04 SYSTEM SPECS, spec 3); no bill builder reads it yet. Owner: Team 1 owns lawmaking, where bill parts are built.
Dated minimum-wage rows for all 56 places, to be integrated into the starting-law wage terms; the file says no game code reads it. Owner: Team 3 owns pay and jobs.
State populations for 2024; nothing reads them yet. Owner: an electorate is population times turnout (A110).

Sourced callback gaps from field experiments, waiting for the hiring engine to read employer attitudes (pool items world-hiring-bias-reasons and world-sale-eligibility-reads); nothing in the engine reads it yet. Owner: Team 3 owns pay and jobs, where an employer's answer to an applicant is decided.
